reviews.review: if you like hacking up orks and other people.. this game is so for you.

FOR THE EMPEROR!

STOMP SMASH KILL BURN.

The metacritic rating for Space Marine is about right (74%), but I thoroughly enjoyed it because the developers painstakingly recreated the 40k universe. I don't think I know if another franchise-based game that feels quite as spot on. With that said, the gameplay does have a few issues. Combat borrows heavily from God of War, with the addition of a solid shooter component (sans cover mechanic, thankfully?); which is to say the combat has variety but lacks real depth. Multiplayer has serious ups and downs, due mostly to the lack of dedicated server support and MASSIVE lag issues if the host is not on your content (which happens about half of the time). The "unlocks" and leveling component offers a few gameplay options without breaking multiplayer. Also included is a co-op "survival" mode (up to 4 players), which only has a few maps but is a riot when you can pull together a few buds for a match. When Space Marine is on sale, it's a great buy for any Warhammer 40k fan.

Ork genocide 101.  The Space Marine campaign is only average, but the game mechanics are well polished and provide the player with excellent control in melee combat, which many games seem come up short.  I'll be honest when I say that the multiplayer is underwhelming.  The are no dedicated servers, which is the achilles heel of PC games.  The PvP is a bit harsh, but manageable with teamwork.  The exterminatus game mode is why I bought Space Marine.  Waves and waves of enemies against you and 3 teammates.  Pure adrenaline, pure massacre, pure fun.

This game is awesome. I normally don't like 3rd person shooter/melee games, but this one works. When I first tried the demo, I didn't like it. Took a second look recently, and something just clicked. Now I LOVE it. 

As a long-time fan of the WH40k universe, this just scratches that Adeptus Astartes itch. Exterminatus mode is a blast. MP is a blast. Customizing my armor/loadout is a blast. That's a lot of blast. In conclusion, I am an instrument of the Emperor's will. I am a weapon in his righteous hand. I am SPACE MARINE.
